title.es: Nuevas recompensas de misiones semanales de nivel máximo de hasta 100 de oro en WoW: Forever

summary.en: New Max Level Weekly Quest Rewards Up to 100 Gold in WoW: Forever...
summary.es: Nuevas recompensas de misiones semanales de nivel máximo de hasta 100 de oro en WoW: Forever...

contentHtml:
Once you reach max level in WoW: Forever, there's a new Weekly Quest that awards a random amount of gold, up to 100 Gold!

There have been some changes to the Gold Economy in WoW: Forever, from the Experience to Gold conversion being disabled, extra Quest Gold for higher level quests, the Auction House Deposit being increased to 1 Silver temporarily on launch, and more. Another change is a new quest for players who reach the max level of 60.

Located in Booty Bay, In Demand - Ancient Elven Curiosities is offered to level 60 players every week. For the two weeks that the game has been active, the quest has been the same both times: collect three items from the three wings of Dire Maul. This quest may change in the future, as we've only seen two weekly resets so far.

 


Once you've completed all three Dire Maul wings and looted all the items, turn in the quest back in Booty Bay to be awarded a Undermine Satchel. This Satchel contains one item that vendors for Gold and some other materials. The Gold item can be:
  • Gold Nugget - Sells for 10g
  • Huge Quartz Gem - Sells for 20g
  • Silver Necklace - Sells for 40g
  • Gold Ring - Sells for 100g
When you open the Bag, summon all your luck to try to hit that jackpot of 100 gold!

title.en: Learning Dual Spec Can Trigger Empty Action Bars When Logging Out in WoW: Forever
title.es: Aprender la especialización dual puede hacer que las barras de acción queden vacías al cerrar sesión en WoW: Forever

summary.en: Learning Dual Spec Can Trigger Empty Action Bars When Logging Out in WoW: Forever...
summary.es: Aprender la especialización dual puede hacer que las barras de acción se queden vacías al cerrar sesión en WoW: Forever...

contentHtml:
Once you learn Dual Spec, a bug can randomly trigger when you log out, wiping abilities off your Action Bars!

Dual Spec can be purchased at level 40 for 50 Gold, allowing you to have a secondary talent tree. However, once you learn Dual Spec, there's an annoying bug that can occur whenever you log out.

For some reason, after you learn Dual Spec, you can randomly have some of your Action Bars reset after you log out. This doesn't always seem to be the case, and it can happen to different bars every time. While this doesn't affect combat capabilities, it can be annoying to log in and see a bar completely reset.


Screenshot Credit: Reloe. After logging in, the top-left bars are missing (Left Image) and have to be reimported (Right Image).


Due to this bug, many players have downloaded the Myslot addon. This addon was designed to help you save and import your UI across accounts, PCs, or on a new alt, but this addon has become very useful for filling your missing Action Bars every time they reset due to this bug.

title.en: Season of Discovery's Scarlet Enclave Raid to Return in WoW: Forever
title.es: La banda del Enclave Escarlata de la Temporada del Descubrimiento volverá a WoW: Forever

summary.en: Season of Discovery's Scarlet Enclave Raid to Return in WoW: Forever...
summary.es: La banda del Enclave Escarlata de la Temporada del Descubrimiento volverá a WoW: Forever...

contentHtml:
In the latest episode of the WoW: Forever podcast, Blizzard has confirmed that the SoD exclusive raid, The Scarlet Enclave, will eventually return in WoW: Forever!



When discussing the potential favorite characters, lore, and stories to bring into the WoW: Forever universe, Aggrend brought up some of his personal favorites, including the Season of Discovery exclusive raid: The Scarlet Enclave.
Aggrend said:
"I mentioned Vol'jin; I think that's one I'm really excited to dive into, but I've been fortunate enough that I've been able to touch the Ashbringer a little bit, you know... Scarlet Enclave will return. The Ashbringer will return at some point; it might be a while, but that's going to come back."
Along with the Scarlet Enclave, the story of The Ashbringer will also return, potentially along with this raid, "at some point" in WoW: Forever. The Scarlet Enclave and The Ashbringer's story, created with familiar lore characters like the Dreadlord Balnazzar, and brand new Scarlet Crusade lore characters such as Caldoran and Beatrix, were very well received as the game's send-off raid before its sunsetting back in May of 2025. Fans of Season of Discovery will be excited to return to this raid eventually in Forever, and the developers seem to be just as excited to share its story once again.

title.es: Descubrimiento de una nueva arma de mago de batalla de alto nivel en WoW: Forever

summary.en: New High Level Battle Mage Weapon Discovered in WoW: Forever...
summary.es: Nuevo arma de mago de batalla de alto nivel descubierta en WoW: Forever...

contentHtml:
Players have discovered a new high-level Battle Mage weapon called Wit's Edge in WoW: Forever!

Battle Mage is an archetype of mage that tends to use spells and melee attacks to defeat their foes. This hasn't been supported in past World of Warcraft, as Mage is traditionally a ranged DPS. With a new level 60 weapon discovered in WoW: Forever, Battle Mages may have some potential at max level!

Wit's Edge
Item Level 65
Binds when picked up
Main HandSword
39 - 74 Damage Speed 2.00
(28.25 damage per second)
+4 Intellect
Classes: Mage
Requires Level 57
Equip: Increases damage and healing done by magical spells and effects by up to 74.
Equip: Your spells pierce 5 Magical Resistance.

Equip: Melee attacks have a 15% chance to grant a Clearcasting state, reducing the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%. (Proc chance: 15%)
Sell Price: 6 13 32


This weapon provides some spell power and spell piercing, but also has a very unique effect: Wit's End. On a melee swing, there's a 15% chance for the Mage to gain Clearcasting. This could lead to some interesting rotations, where Mages want to weave in some melee swings between swings to get free casts.

How to Obtain Wit's End Weapon

Wit's Edge is an item created by using a Scroll of Wit on the Witchblade.
  • Scroll of Wit can be discovered through a Mage's comprehension skill on the level 175 skill scrolls, according to Reddit user Kissta96.
  • Witchblade drops from Darkmaster Gandling in Scholomance.
Combining the two items will grant you a brand new Sword!

summary.es: Los cambios en la clase de chamán mejora ya están disponibles en WoW: Forever...

contentHtml:
Blizzard has confirmed that the Enhancement Shaman changes are now live.

Enhancement Shaman Guide
Blizzard
View Original
Please note:
Due to an unexpected delay in deployment, the following changes went live to all regions at 10:45 a.m. PST today.

Classes

Shaman
  • Weapon imbues and Weapon totems can now be used at the same time.
  • Enhancement
    • Stormstrike damage reduced to 100% weapon damage (was 150%), and cooldown increased to 8 seconds (was 6 seconds).
    • Mental Dexterity: Intellect to Attack Power conversion ratio reduced to 33/66/100% (was 50/100/150%).
    • Maelstrom Weapon now grants 20% reduced cast time and Mana cost per application at all ranks (was 4/8/12/16/20% reduced cast time and Mana cost), and chance to activate now increases with rank and activates 6/7/8/9/10 times per minute (was 20 times per minute regardless of rank).
    • Maelstrom Weapon tooltip updated to display the Shaman’s % chance to activate it based on their Main Hand Weapon’s speed. For example, if the Shaman has the 5 points into Maelstrom Weapon and has a 3.6 speed weapon it will display a 60% chance to activate on swing, compared to if the Shaman is wielding a 2.0 speed weapon it will display a 33% chance to activate on swing.

title.en: "Start Making Other Arrangements" - Josh Greenfield on Locking Character Creation on PvP Rulesets
title.es: «Empezad a hacer otros planes»: Josh Greenfield sobre la limitación de la creación de personajes en los conjuntos de reglas JcJ

summary.en: "Start Making Other Arrangements" - Josh Greenfield on Locking Character Creation on PvP Rulesets...
summary.es: «Empezad a hacer otros planes»: Josh Greenfield sobre la limitación de la creación de personajes en los conjuntos de reglas JcJ...

contentHtml:
In episode 7 of the WoW: Forever podcast, Josh Greenfield comments on locking character creation on PvP rulesets, noting that Horde players who have not made a character on most PvP and RP-PVP realms should "start making other arrangements".

A few days ago, Blizzard announced that they are addressing overall faction balance on PvP servers. To do this, they made it harder to create a character on the more popular faction on PvP and RP-PVP realms, most of which are Horde. In the most recent podcast episode, Josh Greenfield (Aggrend) recommends that players who are looking to roll on those most populous factions should "start making other arrangements." This likely indicates that this faction lock will be in place for a longer period of time.
[...]We've kind of tightened it up a little bit. Unfortunately, that means if you haven't made a Horde character, you're going to want to start making other arrangements at this point because we kind of had to clamp that down.
Aggrend comments that one of the most important things on a PvP server is faction balance, and so they're super dedicated to maintaining that balance. Blizzard allows for a 10% delta typically on launch, and they've hit that cap currently. He also announced that they have recently checked the balance on a zone level and made some tweaks, so it should feel more fair on a zone level.

Lastly, he commented on the rumour that players were using Trial accounts or level 1 characters to skew the faction balance. Aggrend directly says, "That does not have an impact. That is not how the system works."
